description: List every decision, approval, key or manual step the team is waiting on the user for. Each says you_can_answer: an ordinary decision or approval you may answer with gates_answer; the rest (money, keys and passwords, manual steps, anything marked for the user) only the user answers, so tell the user. For a key, answer_at is a one-time secure link when the box can make one: give it to the user, never ask them to type the key in this chat.
name: gates_list
